# The Obstacle Course Game You’ve Been Waiting For!

**RUN, JUMP, PUNCH & SMASH** your way through 40+ levels and dungeons in this retro-themed VR platformer & obstacle course game. Filled with tough challenges, inventive obstacles, treasures to collect and secrets to discover.

![{"height":320,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974469_465167519875389_7799963844292711505_n.png?_nc_cat=103&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=TlZ4vPEIgs4Q7kNvgHzgmhY&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYA0dsfcVkWvsiN3BjhwUa76q-fxpMWcZcPOYIx03U8fGQ&oe=67502AD5)

# 7 Worlds To Discover

- Honeywood Hills
- Cookie Crumble
- Sky Brick Road
- Jump N' Jammy
- Arctic Freeze
- Dark Citadel 
- Cybertron

![{"height":316,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57570288_519192850905056_7008045554147306501_n.png?_nc_cat=109&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=0k60WeAzOOQQ7kNvgFguJ1u&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYB1rHLnipaspD1PjB0nl3usYrgfaAbFYv0z83nnzcbsuw&oe=67502D62)

# Easy To Pickup And Play

- Play Seated or Standing.
- Movement - Left & Right Thumbsticks.
- Jump - A Button or Click Right Thumbstick.
- Dash - Click Left Thumbstick.
- Ground Smash - While in Air, Press Trigger.

![{"height":320,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38984458_467766535619537_6073863993821564424_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=W1kucvDHX3IQ7kNvgH057pY&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYB6Ax_fQM60oIljBkPz02mo5mVU-xzAxfX2wpODKZputw&oe=675052C5)
# Face the final challenge. Enter each of the 7 Dungeons and see if you have what it takes to unlock the next world.
- Untimed so you can progress at your own pace.
- Reach the gates to unlock checkpoints.
- Dungeons designed with platforming in mind.

![{"height":320,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75221317_543457818269844_6485753983236722891_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=5sLDvs1Ds7MQ7kNvgE7XWEa&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBvd4IX_IyqKgXzPcgBf3XRFld5o2vlyWBJp9vEUikW7Q&oe=67503BFF)
# Race To The Finish Line!
- Race against your own time.
- Compete to achieve Bronze, Silver or Gold Trophies!
- You aren't penalized for a lack of skill.
- As long as you can complete each course, you can progress!
- Keep practicing and you'll do GREAT!
